study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized cerebellar damage predicts the presence of behavioral disorders in children with brainstem tumors

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: fcon_1000.projects (FCON, n=69); Child Connectome Project (devCCNP, n=450); locally recruited children in Beijing (n=61); Children's Hospital in Guangzhou (n=269); Beijing Tiantan Hospital (patients, n=147)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: data from 849 healthy children were collected from publicly available databases, including 72 locally recruited children in Beijing (61 of whom underwent scanning), 69 from the fcon_1000.projects dataset ... 450 from the Child Connectome Project (CCNP), and 269 from the Children's Hospital in Guangzhou. ... 171 pediatric patients (age range: 4 -17 years) diagnosed with brainstem tumors at the Department of Neurosurgery, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, were enrolled
